job_post_list.title: Manager, Finance Business Partner
job_post_list.description:
1.Business Partnership & Decision Support
• Develop a thorough understanding of virtual banking products, user acquisition, and revenue models.
• Partner with business leaders to establish a sound analytical framework, offer actionable insights, and drive solutions that support both strategic and tactical decisions.
2.Financial Analysis & Performance Management
• Lead end to end financial evaluations for new products and projects, including pricing strategy, cost modelling, and profitability health checks; build scalable forecasting and analytical tools.
• Deliver regular multi dimensional management reports covering business KPIs, operational trends, and competitive benchmarking.
• Define key performance indicators and dashboards that reflect business realities, and maintain a continuous feedback loop with operational teams.
3.Risk Monitoring & Control
• Identify and assess financial risks in business initiatives; design and implement tracking mechanisms for both financial and operational metrics.
• Monitor critical projects and high priority areas on an ongoing basis, providing timely updates and risk alerts.
4.Budgeting & Forecasting
• Lead the annual budgeting and periodic forecasting processes for assigned business units; analyse variances and support business heads in managing budgets effectively.
• Ensure business teams meet KPIs within approved financial parameters.
5.Daily Finance Operations
• Oversee expense accrual, contract review, and monthly management reporting with insightful commentary.
job_post_list.requirement:
• Minimum 5 years of progressive finance/accounting experience, ideally with exposure to banking, fintech, or internet financial services.
• Bachelor’s degree or above from a recognised university.
• Excellent command of English (written and spoken); Cantonese is a strong plus.
• Big 4 banking audit, commercial banking, or fintech/brokerage/wealth management experience.
• Familiarity with user operations or wealth management products is highly advantageous.
• Financial Acumen: Ability to translate business changes into P&L impacts and forecast future financial outcomes with confidence.
• Risk Awareness: Capable of identifying potential financial risks in business proposals and recommending mitigations.
• Business Insight: Quickly grasp new business models and operational nuances.
• Communication & Collaboration: Strong stakeholder management skills; able to coordinate across finance functions and engage proactively with business front‑line teams.
• Proactive & Curious: Self‑starter with a strong sense of ownership, intellectual curiosity, and a willingness to work in a fast‑paced environment.

job_post_list.title: Brand Manager
job_post_list.description:
About the Role

ZA Bank is for those who dare to reshape what banking can be—digitally native, socially connected, and relentlessly customer-first. As our next Brand Manager, you won’t just run campaigns; you’ll set new standards for creativity, customer obsession, and business impact in Hong Kong’s fintech landscape. You’ll envision and co-create the next generation of brand experiences, harness the power of AI, and turn every touchpoint into a moment that earns loyalty and sparks conversation. You are the voice of our customers, our creative engine, and the strategic mind who can see where the market is heading—and lead us there.



Your Mission & Key Priorities

Brand Campaign Visionary: Envision and architect integrated brand campaigns that don’t just meet objectives, but redefine what’s possible for digital banking in Hong Kong. Lead creative ideation and direction for all public-facing communications—print, digital, social, and video—setting a new creative benchmark for the category. Inspire teams and partners to create bold, culture-driving work that’s unmistakably ZA.
AI Marketing Leadership: Pioneer the adoption of AI-powered marketing, unlocking new levels of personalization, automation, and impact—turning insights into unforgettable customer experiences. Collaborate cross-functionally to embed AI, predictive analytics, and content intelligence into every campaign and lifecycle communication. Position ZA Bank as an innovation leader by envisioning how AI can not only optimize, but transform, our marketing game.
Customer Journey Orchestration: Re-imagine the end-to-end customer journey, championing seamless, emotionally resonant experiences that delight at every stage. Turn customer insights, pain points, and moments of truth into actionable, business-driving strategies—making ZA the most loved brand in the market. Be the customer’s voice in every strategic forum, ensuring our promise is felt in every interaction.
Social Marketing Excellence: Shape ZA Bank’s social presence into the most engaging, buzzworthy, and authentic in Hong Kong banking. Set the pace on social content, influencer partnerships, and real-time engagement—turning trends into brand moments and customers into advocates. Envision social as an engine for brand love, not just awareness—creating content that people want to share and talk about.
Marketing Events & Partnerships: Imagine and execute signature events, pop-ups, and collaborations that make headlines and bring our brand to life—on the street, online, and in culture.
Forge breakthrough partnerships with creators, startups, and brands that expand our reach and cultural relevance. Lead the team in designing immersive, memorable experiences that create lasting business and brand impact.
job_post_list.requirement:
What We’re Looking For

Strategic Vision: Proven ability to see the big picture, anticipate trends, and set a bold agenda for brand and marketing.
Creative Leadership: Hands-on experience leading creative ideation, developing briefs, and guiding teams/agencies to award-worthy work.
Experience: 6+ years in brand management, integrated marketing, or customer experience—ideally in digital-first, high-growth environments.
Business Acumen: Ability to connect brand, campaign, and customer strategy to business KPIs and commercial outcomes.
Customer Obsession: Relentless focus on customer insights and experience; turns feedback into action that surprises and delights.
AI & Digital Fluency: Comfortable with AI-driven marketing tools, analytics, and martech; ready to push boundaries.
Communication: Exceptional written and verbal skills; confident presenting to senior leaders and external partners.
Project Management: Strong multitasking, organizational, and decision-making skills. -Social DNA: Deep understanding of social platforms, influencer culture, and digital trends in Hong Kong.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, or related field.

job_post_list.title: Product Manager, Retail Banking
job_post_list.description:
• Independently drive the planning and iteration of retail products (covering Deposits, Payments, Foreign Exchange, Cross-border services, etc.), managing the full lifecycle from requirement discovery to launch and go-live.
• Deeply understand user needs and business objectives; produce high-quality product proposals, PRDs, and prototypes; facilitate efficient collaboration across Design, Development, QA, and Operations teams.
• Adopt a data-driven decision-making approach—continuously monitor core product metrics, and leverage A/B testing, user research, and other methods to optimise product experience and business outcomes.
• Work closely with internal support functions including Compliance, Risk Management, and Finance to drive product innovation and rapid delivery within the regulatory framework.
job_post_list.requirement:
• 3+ years of product management experience in Internet, Fintech, or Payment industries, with a proven track record of end-to-end delivery on C side retail product projects.
• Strong learning agility—able to quickly grasp new business domains and chart clear paths amid uncertainty.
• Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills—capable of driving complex projects, aligning multiple stakeholders, and ensuring efficient execution.
• Logical mindset with strong data sensitivity—able to validate hypotheses and drive product decisions with data.
• High sense of ownership and results-orientation—proactive in problem-solving without rigid boundaries.
Nice-to-Haves
• Hands-on experience in AI application (e.g., AI assistants, AI-driven operational tools), and a solid understanding of AI technology’s use cases and boundaries in financial scenarios.
• Familiarity with Hong Kong’s financial regulatory environment; experience in building products from 0 to 1.
• Good written and spoken English, with the ability to thrive in an international, multi-cultural team environment.

job_post_list.title: Head of Sales
job_post_list.description:
As the Head of Sales, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our sales strategy, managing a high-performing team, and building strong relationships with clients and partners. Your responsibilities will include:
1.	Sales Strategy and Leadership:
•	Develop and implement effective sales strategies to achieve company revenue and growth targets.
•	Lead, motivate, and manage the sales team to ensure optimal performance and alignment with company goals.
•	Monitor market trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities and risks.
•	Prepare regular sales reports and forecasts for senior management, providing insights and recommendations.
•	Closely work with the Director, RO, referrers and back-office colleagues to maintain strong relationships with these key stakeholders to ensure smooth collaboration.
2.	Team Management and Development:
•	Recruit, train, and mentor sales staff, fostering a culture of excellence and collaboration.
•	Set clear sales targets and KPIs for the team, and ensure regular performance evaluations. 
•	Formulate and review the compensation scheme of the sales team to ensure proper incentivization while aligning with the company’s financial goals.
•	Ensure the team adheres to compliance requirements set by the Insurance Authority and other relevant regulatory bodies.
•	Uphold service quality standards by monitoring client interactions and providing feedback to improve customer satisfaction.
•	Provide ongoing coaching and support to improve individual and team performance.
3.	Personal Sales Contribution:
•	Actively participate in sales activities as assigned, focusing on serving high-value customers and delivering tailored insurance solutions.
•	Build strong relationships with high-net-worth individuals and corporate clients, ensuring satisfaction and loyalty.
•	Set a good example for the team by demonstrating best practices in sales techniques, client engagement, and professional conduct.
job_post_list.requirement:
To excel in this role, you should possess the following qualifications and skills:
1.	Experience:
•	Minimum 10 years of experience in insurance sales
•	Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets in the insurance industry, preferably in Hong Kong.
•	Relevant experience as a responsible officer of an insurance broker in Hong Kong will be given priority consideration.
2.	Industry Knowledge:
•	Strong understanding of the life insurance products and the needs of different customer segments, including local market and MCV market.
•	Familiarity with Hong Kong’s insurance regulations and market dynamics.
3.	Leadership Skills:
•	Exceptional leadership and team management abilities, with a focus on motivating and developing talent.
•	Strategic thinker with the ability to drive results and adapt to changing market conditions.
4.	Interpersonal Skills:
•	Strong sense of ownership and responsibility, with innovative thinking, agility and entrepreneurship
•	Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to build relationships at all levels.

• 具备银行 App 平台产品、存款产品或支付产品相关经验。
• 有独立撰写需求文档、主导需求沟通与评审的实操经验，并独立负责过产品从 0 到 1 的落地。
• 沟通协调能力强，能有效推动跨部门协作；抗压能力强，能适应快节奏与多项目并行。
• 主动学习能力强，善用 AI 工具提升需求撰写、资料分析与方案产出效率。

job_post_list.title: 财务系统运维工程师
job_post_list.description:
一、Oracle NetSuite 运维
- 负责 NetSuite 云 ERP 的日常运维与支持，包括账号与角色权限管理、工作流与审批流配置、系统参数调整；
- 支撑月结、年结关键节点：关账前的数据检查、期间打开与锁定、异常事务排查，保障关账按期完成；
- 响应财务用户的系统问题（工单），定位并解决录入报错、数据异常、报表取数问题，必要时对接 Oracle 官方支持或实施合作伙伴；
- 参与系统变更管理：需求评估、配置变更、上线后验证，编写操作文档与用户培训材料。
二、汇联易费用管理平台运维
- 负责汇联易企业费用 / 差旅报销平台的日常运维：报销流程与审批流配置、费用政策规则维护、发票 OCR 识别与合规校验问题处理；
- 保障汇联易与 NetSuite 总账的集成稳定：自动凭证生成、科目映射、月末对账，及时处理集成失败与数据不一致问题；
- 解答员工报销相关的系统问题，持续优化报销体验与合规管控。
三、财务管理 AI 开发项目
- 使用 AI Coding 工具（如 Cursor、GitHub Copilot、Claude Code 等）参与财务管理方向的系统与工具开发：对账与结账自动化、预算与费用分析、财务报表自动化；
- 探索 LLM / AI Agent 在财务管理场景的落地：财务智能问答、单据与发票识别、异常检测、预算与费用分析、审批流自动化等 PoC 与项目交付；
- 将财务管理中重复性的人工操作沉淀为脚本与自动化流程，持续降低人工操作比例。
job_post_list.requirement:
- 1–2 年财务系统运维、实施或开发经验，有 Oracle NetSuite 运维或实施经验者优先，有汇联易等费用管理平台经验者优先；
- 熟悉财务核心流程与概念：总账、应付、应收、月结年结、多币种核算；
- 具备扎实的 SQL 能力，能独立完成数据查询、核对与修复；掌握 Python 或 JavaScript 基础，能读懂并维护脚本；
- 有实际的 AI Coding 经验：能熟练使用 Cursor / Copilot 等工具完成财务管理相关的开发任务，了解 LLM API 调用、Prompt 编写，有个人或团队 AI 项目作品优先；
- 良好的沟通能力与业务理解力，能与财务团队高效协作，把业务语言翻译为系统方案；
- 具备中英文读写能力，能处理英文系统文档与跨国沟通。
加分项
- 熟悉 NetSuite SuiteScript（2.0）、Saved Search、SuiteFlow 工作流开发者优先；
- 有费用管理 / 报销系统（汇联易、Concur、分贝通、汇联易等）实施或运维经验优先；
- 对财务自动化、RPA、AI Agent 有实践或深入研究者优先；
- 有 Oracle NetSuite 相关认证（如 SuiteFoundation）优先。
